name: edge-spec
description: Find untested code, generate tests with the model you choose, and open a pull request.

scripts.dev:worker: bun run build:worker && bun run --cwd infra dev
scripts.docs:deploy: bun run docs:build && bunx wrangler pages deploy apps/docs/.vitepress/dist --project-name edge-spec-docs --branch main
scripts.deploy:stage: bun run build && bun run --cwd infra deploy --stage
scripts.test:stack: bun run build && bun run --cwd infra test
scripts.build: bun run build:web && bun run build:worker
scripts.deploy: bun run build && bun run alchemy deploy --stage prod
scripts.verify: bun run format:check && bun run lint && bun check . && bun run test
